description: **Go binary releases publish their archives again.** The generated Go publish workflow now creates the bare `vX.Y.Z` tag goreleaser reads before running it, so a monorepo releasable whose tags are prefixed (`name@vX.Y.Z`) no longer fails the build with `couldn't get tag contents` -- which shipped a GitHub Release carrying zero archives while the release reported success. The goreleaser version is pinned exactly instead of floating on `~> v2`, so no scaffolded project adopts a goreleaser release on its own. Re-run `rlsbl scaffold` to pick this up.
